article.title: The effect of probiotic and synbiotic supplementation on sleep parameters in exercised population: a systematic review and synthesis without meta-analysis (SWiM) of randomized controlled trials.
article.authors: Salehi Asl M, Ahmadi F, Ershadmanesh M
article.abstract: Sleep is crucial for recovery and optimal performance in athletes; however, poor sleep is common during periods of intensive training or competition. The microbiota-gut-brain axis suggests probiotics and synbiotics could modulate sleep, but evidence in exercised populations is limited.
